listing.name: Theme Hospital / Theme Hospital Enhanced
listing.summary: Explore Theme Hospital / Theme Hospital Enhanced and follow the upstream project for requirements, downloads and setup.

steps.title: Use the appropriate runtime
steps.instruction: This project reconstructs the DOS Theme Hospital executable. Its hospital.exe/hosp.exe outputs use DOS/4GW and are documented for DOSBox, so they are not native Windows game players to register directly. Follow upstream’s DOS build/run guide for that project. For a separately managed native Theme Hospital route, look for CorsixTH in Discover; the two projects keep their own identities.
